name: Kingdom of Egypt
alt: Kingdom of Egypt and the Sudan

predecessors.name: Sultanate of Egypt
predecessors.text: Egypt: the British protectorate that Britain 'officially recognised ... independence' of in February 1922

successors.name: Republic of Egypt
successors.text: Egypt: 'The Free Officers abolished the monarchy, and declared Egypt a republic on 18 June 1953'

rulers.name: Farouk I
rulers.title: King of Egypt, and the Sudan from October 1951

ledger.x: 28 February 1922: Britain recognises Egyptian independence; the Sultanate becomes the Kingdom.
22 September 1948: Egypt declares the All-Palestine Protectorate in Gaza.
16 October 1951: Egypt abrogates the condominium and proclaims Farouk 'King of Egypt and the Sudan'.

wars.name: 1948 Arab-Israeli War (Egyptian front)
wars.outcome: Egypt advanced to Beersheba and Isdud but was halted by Israel (Operation Pleshet, 29 May to 3 June 1948); the armistice of 24 February 1949 left it the Gaza Strip, under the All-Palestine Protectorate from 22 September 1948.

certainty.note: Straight administrative lines in Cliopatria (22 N with the Sudan, 25 E with Libya) and the Suez Canal Zone base of the 1936 treaty; no page opened describes a survey, and the Libyan and Sudanese frontiers were not read.
Front lines of the first war in the Negev and Gaza; the Egyptian positions changed with each truce.
The 24 February 1949 armistice fixed the boundaries of the Gaza Strip.
